summary: A large, complex structure featuring a central cross-shaped building with a prominent, curved brick roof and two tall watchtowers located on one side. The entire complex is surrounded by a low white perimeter wall and sits on a dirt foundation. The buildings utilize a consistent color palette of light walls, white accents, and stone brick bases.

shape.overall_form: Central cross-shaped main building with two detached towers on one side, enclosed by a rectangular wall.
shape.symmetry: Main building has bilateral symmetry; overall complex is asymmetrical due to tower placement.

rebuild_hints: Begin by laying out the rectangular dirt foundation and the low white perimeter wall.
Construct the two identical watchtowers on one side of the enclosure using stone brick for the corners and sandstone for the faces.
The main building has a cross-shaped footprint; build the walls with a stone brick base, followed by sandstone layers separated by white horizontal bands and vertical pillars.
The roof is the most challenging aspect, requiring intersecting curved sections (vaults/domes) made of brick blocks and stairs, with glass blocks embedded as skylights.
uncertainties: The exact material used for the white blocks (could be quartz, white concrete, or smooth diorite) and the light yellow walls (could be sandstone, end stone, or terracotta).
The interior layout, floor plans, and overall purpose of the complex are completely unknown.
